_about: On This Day in Longhorn history. Keys are MM-DD. Every entry must have a source link.

11-17.text: No. 15 Texas beat No. 16 Iowa State 24-10 at Royal-Memorial Stadium.
Texas beat Oklahoma 26-14 at Clark Field in Austin.

11-18.text: Texas won 28-14 at West Virginia in Morgantown.
Texas shut out Arkansas 34-0 in Fayetteville.

11-19.text: Bijan Robinson ran for 243 yards and four touchdowns as Texas routed Kansas 55-14 in Lawrence.

11-21.text: In his last home game, Colt McCoy threw for 396 yards and four TDs in a 51-20 win over Kansas, becoming the winningest QB in college football history.

11-22.text: Arch Manning accounted for four touchdowns as Texas beat Arkansas 52-37.

11-23.text: No. 5 Texas beat Texas A&M 21-7 at Kyle Field.
No. 5 Texas shut out Texas A&M 25-0 in College Station on Thanksgiving Day.

11-24.text: Texas won 27-25 at Kyle Field in the last Thanksgiving meeting with Texas A&M before the Aggies left for the SEC.
No. 12 Texas beat No. 22 Texas A&M 43-17 in Austin.
